talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $130.8M sold across 6 Form D filings this week, down 67% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was iReprogram, Inc (Ann Arbor, Biotechnology) targeting $25M. Good question to ask: are founders in health care & life sciences favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

2 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $130M raised so far — led by Blackford Capital Opportunity Fund II, LP (Private Equity Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?

Mat Ishbia and others reported a 79.4% stake in UWM Holdings Corporation (UWMC) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 16). Schedule 13D filers can push for strategic change, so it's worth asking whether shareholders see a sale or restructuring on the table.
